snippet.title: TIERRA - TRAILER - Point & Click Graphic Adventure Game (Mobile, Tablet and PC)
snippet.description:
🍏 https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tierra-adventure-mystery/id1568117390
🤖 https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=co.uk.m9games.tierra
STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1686980/TIERRA__Mystery_Point__Click_Adventure/
itch: https://m9-games.itch.io/tierra

Recently you have been taking life a little easier. After your recent adventure to the island of AYUDA and the discovery of the treasure, the hiking and puzzle solving had taken its toll.

The journey had been tough and you thought a more sedate walk through the woodland area more locally would aid in your recovery.

However, on following a downloaded orienteering map, you soon discover buildings and locations not listed on the map.

Your inquisitive nature kicks in and you decide to investigate further to see where these strange pathways lead and what secrets the buildings may hold.
